title: Ben Johnson originally called a punt, but Cairo Santos asked to try a 58-yard field goal

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Ben Johnson originally called a punt, but Cairo Santos asked to try a 58-yard field goal
sources.description: After Bears head coach Ben Johnson initially called for a punt late in Thursday night's win over the Patriots, Bears kicker Cairo Santos convinced his coaches to let him try the 58-yard field goal that sealed the win.
